step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows content originators and media outlets interacting with Adbridge platform. Requests enter via ELB inspected by AWS WAF (Firewall), which routes to an App EC2 instance. Content is uploaded to S3 directly or via app servers. SQS manages asynchronous task distribution to QC Transcoding and Batch EC2 instances. Processed assets are stored in S3 and delivered to Media Outlets directly or via CloudFront.

graph.name: Extreme Reach Adbridge Architecture
